string.text: Vodka "Nemiroff"

Nemiroff is a Ukrainian alcoholic beverage manufacturer specializing mainly in the supply of vodka. It was founded in the city of Nemirov, Vinnytsia region. One of the best vodkas in the world and in the Zone, but you should not abuse it. Unscrupulous stalkers often slip others a stick, diluting alcohol with water and pouring the whole thing into an empty bottle of everyone's favorite vodka.
 
 %c[ui_gray_3]NOTE: 
 %c[ui_gray_1]Everyone knows that this brand of alcohol is preferred by one of the researchers at the MBU on Yantar, who also works as a cook. Rumor has it that he's even willing to barter for army gear in exchange for a couple bottles of vodka. However, these are just rumors.

Putinka vodka

Following the strange tradition of naming vodka brands in Russia by the name of the supreme leader, Putinka went into production for the first time after Vladimir Putin was elected president. It is made in Russia from the best grain and crystal clear water from Siberian springs. The triple degree of purification, smooth texture, unique taste and many other characteristics make this product a reputation. Drink in moderation.

Purified water

Military flasks are designed for drinking water in small sips. The supply of clean water from the mainland is an expensive pleasure. Therefore, drinking water is mainly extracted and purified right in the Zone. The presence of disinfectants, containers, fire, knowledge and a little experience will allow any stalker to get clean water for himself. Thanks to wells, open water sources and frequent rains, water can be found almost everywhere in the Zone. Despite the relatively easy cleaning method, this is mainly done by bartenders, as they always have everything they need, including free time. And due to the large containers, they can purify quite a large amount of water at one time.

Beard Tea

Popular among stalkers is hot tea according to Beard's recipe, infused with edible dried mushrooms in boiled water with added sugar. Stalkers who can afford to buy this drink often take it with them on long walks around the Zone. It's a pretty good and relatively healthy way to stay on your feet when you're tired or waiting out cold, dark nights. This tea also helps to cope with the symptoms of radiation exposure, which makes it even more useful during long trips. Unfortunately, or fortunately, Beard himself does not reveal the secret of why his tea removes radiation.

Beef stew

Stew is a common name for canned stewed meat produced in the Soviet Union and other Warsaw Pact countries. The irony is that the idea of such a product came to Russia during World War II in the form of aid from the United States. Since then, various types of stew have become the main means of long-term storage of meat, which is used by both the civilian population and the ranks of the army. It is worth noting that despite the long shelf life, the stew has a high nutritional value (due to its high fat content) and a relatively good taste. The Chernobyl Exclusion Zone has seen many varieties of stew. Since the spring of 2013, the chopped meat of the Abakan brand has remained the undisputed leader among other canned goods.

MRE

The Meal, Ready-to-Eat (commonly known as the MRE) is a self-contained, individual field ration in lightweight packaging, developed by the United States military for its service members for use in combat or other field conditions where organised food facilities are not available. One MRE can be used as one meal. The packaging of an MRE is designed to withstand rough conditions and exposure to the elements. Contains one course along with a variety of other food and drink items. While it can be eaten cold, it usually tastes much better when heated up with the included flameless ration heater (FRH, a water-activated exothermic reaction device that emits heat).

Breakfast, dinner and supper all in one package. Includes various food items whose function is to provide the body with all minerals and microelements essential for your health as well as cooking equipment (small metal frame, fuel tablets, matches, striker) and other items (e.g. napkins) facilitating use in field conditions. Comes with a polymeric box that protects the ingredients from hazardous environmental conditions. The polymeric box has 3 sections, each respectively for breakfast, dinner and supper.

"The Beak" is a powerful mixture of Zone-produced vodka and pulverised beak of a black crow. But not every beak is suitable as an ingredient, but only the beak of males who have been in the Zone for more than 15 years, as their beak is more susceptible to mutation. Rumor has it that such beaks are highly enriched in protein, which, along with vodka, removes radiation from the body. Some people say that drinking this mixture gives you a feeling of wings growing for a few seconds. The taste, however, could not be worse.
